rule: Battlefield match: queue fills to corps size times two, then a 20 s start countdown, then play for time_playing minutes (or until a side reaches victory_score), then a result that stays for time_ending minutes before the instance is removed. Roaming big monster: roam point within a 6-unit square around its idle point, pause 3 to 5 s, repeat; switch to attack on aggro. Cron-gated spawners and doodads: a day-of-week and clock window in minutes plus start and end dates per schedule row.

data_fields.name: corps_spawn_point
data_fields.unit: zone id plus X, Y, Z (game units)

data_fields.name: roam_radius
data_fields.unit: game units (square half-width 6, unit not checked)

look_test: At 375 wide: a queue card reading 'three of six for the match' with a fill bar; a 20-second countdown on the match card; a live score line with a name; a result card for 10 seconds. Separately, one roaming boss that wanders six units, pauses three to five seconds, and turns to attack when a player enters its aggro ring. Dom judges whether the queue fill reads at a glance, whether the score line feels like a live contest, and whether the wander-and-pause reads as a boss waiting.
